claim: `status` lists biomes, layers, quota, cavern line, on-the-map counts, the invasion field, and the embark subset
`now` applies the current season's roster once and reports the active count
`enable` / `disable` start and stop automatic rotation (registers/cancels the daily scheduler)
`classes` prints the seven ecology classes with on/off and counts, plus the unclassified review list
`class <TOKEN> <cls>` records an override; bad args print usage
`groups` prints resident-group status (max, gap, detached, coupling, cohesion, swept) and the ecology line
`groups on|off` enables/disables resident groups
`groups coupling on|off` (and the `piggyback` alias) sets migratory coupling
`groups pack N` sets the coupled predator wave size; 0 = raws
`groups ecology [on|off|now]` reads, sets, or runs the ecology write once
`groups livestock on|off` makes the fort's animals targets
`groups nudge TILES TICKS RADIUS` changes the three nudge distances
`groups cohesion on|off|herd N pack N flock N` sets cohesion and follow distances and reports groups led
`groups hold TOKEN DAYS` raises every member's leave countdown; `groups dismiss TOKEN` zeroes it and clears the leader
`quota [land|water|cavern] N` sets a per-layer ceiling; 0 unsets; status shows effective values and what is on the map
`quota cavern N` warns that the ceiling is enforced on FREQUENCY and brakes arrivals rather than culling
`water [on|off|now|target N|cadence N|countdown N]` controls the water job; status names live/dormant with the reason
`place TOKEN [n] [layer]` places wild animals headlessly and debits the entry
an unknown verb prints usage rather than a stack trace
bad arguments to water/quota/class/hold/place print a usage line and change nothing
the launcher help (`help seasonal-wildlife`) describes the tool
enable registers a daily repeat-util job; disable cancels it
applying the roster writes pool quantities: in-season allowed species stocked, out-of-season zeroed
applying a different season zeroes the species that season excludes
a creature with no seasons assigned is not managed at all
Force wave clears the current group and a new wave arrives within a few thousand ticks
resident groups tracks wildlife groups on the map (gated/resident rows with arrival day)
cohesion picks a leader per herd/pack/flock group and sets followers
the leader is the lowest-id member (NOT the largest male — that is backlog)
hold raises leave_countdown on every member to ≥ DAYS×1200 ticks
dismiss zeroes leave_countdown and clears the leader
the ecology write relates every LARGE_PREDATOR to every target in DF's reaction cache and reports the pair count
the ecology job fires on its own every 1,500 ticks while enabled
a predator >40 tiles from every target for 3,000 ticks is moved to within 6
place puts N live wild units on walkable tiles with a population ref, debits the entry by N, and they survive stepping
on a dry/inland fort the water layer is dormant and the status names WHICH test failed
on a lake fort the water layer is live and `water now` places animals from stocked, in-season water entries
water target / cadence / countdown are stored and reported
quota land N overrides groups.max_concurrent as the effective ceiling
quota water N overrides the water target as the effective stocking level
quota cavern N holds managed cavern species at frequency 1 while over the ceiling; frequency is never written 0
QUOTA.cavernThrottle (the old entry-quantity ceiling) still prints a 'cavern ceiling' line — a second mechanism for the same setting, measured inert (T7)
disable (or quota cavern 0) restores every held cavern frequency
the layer counter separates land/water/cavern and reports the magma sea and underworld as a never-managed deep bucket
DF invasions are excluded from every count via a real unit field
a creature in a disabled class is locked: not eligible, shows an L tag, cannot be allowed
a class override changes the creature's class on the next pool build
`overlay enable seasonal-wildlife.groups` registers a map overlay marking each tracked group g/r
a tracked non-flier that has not moved in 5,000 ticks is re-grounded; the status counts swept=N
Add-new writes a master row and a live entry so the species is in the pool with no reload

claim: Reset to default restores managed quantities to the captured worldgen snapshot and abundances to 50
abundance sets the stocked quantity (not arrival volume — E24)
a full session of console and GUI use leaves the save byte-identical (config lives in persistent site data)
the roster is re-applied at each season boundary and held daily against refunds
when a prey group arrives, coupling closes the pool to its armed natural predators for up to two days
`gui/seasonal-wildlife` opens a resizable 86×34 window titled 'Seasonal Wildlife' with five tabs
Roster tab: header with biomes and per-category counts, filter row, creature list with cat/size/biome/season/ab/ok columns, action keys, status line
Set roster tab: per-category targets, fill keys, season grid, matrix/co-align keys, grid status
Food web tab: ecology-switch line, season selector, chains (All) or trophic pyramid + aquatic mini-web (a season)
Live tab: resident-group status, tracked groups, ecology line, wild-on-map by race, quota line, cavern line, biomass ratio
Seasons tab: four seasons side by side, one row per allowed creature under its trophic level, +/-/X/. marks
ESC closes the window
Ctrl-modified action keys work while the filter box has focus (USAGE: 'that is why all action keys are Ctrl-modified here')
the Roster tab's status line shows each action's receipt ('Applied Spring live: N active.', 'Set N abundances to 60.', 'Auto rotation ON.')
the Set-roster tab's grid status shows each action's receipt ('Allowed N natural prey.', 'Assigned matrix seasons to N creatures.')
V cycles View: Current → Default → Add-new
C cycles the category filter (incl. aquatic)

N cycles the season filter

Y allows the natural prey of allowed creatures
